test-directions.title: Perdu près de la gare

sentences.french: Je suis devant la gare mais je ne sais pas où aller.
sentences.english: I'm in front of the station but I don't know where to go.

sentences.french: Je demande à un passant : « Où est la boulangerie ? »
sentences.english: I ask a passerby: 'Where is the bakery?'

sentences.french: Il me dit : « Allez tout droit, puis tournez à gauche. »
sentences.english: He tells me: 'Go straight ahead, then turn left.'

sentences.french: Je marche lentement et je regarde les enseignes.
sentences.english: I walk slowly and look at the signs.

sentences.french: La boulangerie est juste en face de la pharmacie.
sentences.english: The bakery is right across from the pharmacy.

sentences.french: Enfin, je sens l'odeur du pain frais.
sentences.english: Finally, I smell the scent of fresh bread.

test-directions.fullTranslation: I'm in front of the station but I don't know where to go. I ask a passerby: 'Where is the bakery?' He tells me: 'Go straight ahead, then turn left.' I walk slowly and look at the signs. The bakery is right across from the pharmacy. Finally, I smell the scent of fresh bread.

session5-paris-secrets.title: Les secrets de Paris

sentences.french: Paris est particulièrement connue.
sentences.english: Paris is particularly well-known.

sentences.french: Elle est également connue sous le nom de Ville Lumière.
sentences.english: It is also known by the name City of Light.

sentences.french: Les enfants jouent souvent en plein air.
sentences.english: Children often play outdoors.

sentences.french: Il y a beaucoup d'endroits à visiter.
sentences.english: There are many places to visit.

sentences.french: Pour n'en citer que trois : le Louvre, Montmartre et la Seine.
sentences.english: To name just three: the Louvre, Montmartre, and the Seine.

sentences.french: Voici une anecdote amusante.
sentences.english: Here is a funny anecdote.

sentences.french: Savez-vous que sa taille a changé plusieurs fois ?
sentences.english: Did you know that its height has changed several times?

sentences.french: Rien que cette histoire vaut le détour.
sentences.english: That story alone is worth the detour.

sentences.french: Son guide pense que c'est vrai.
sentences.english: His guide thinks it's true.

sentences.french: Car il l'a lu dans un livre.
sentences.english: Because he read it in a book.

sentences.french: À ce moment-là, tout le monde a attendu.
sentences.english: At that moment, everyone waited.

sentences.french: Avez-vous visité ses endroits préférés ?
sentences.english: Have you visited his favorite places?

sentences.french: Il faut y aller vite.
sentences.english: You have to go quickly.

sentences.french: Car rien ne dure pour toujours.
sentences.english: Because nothing lasts forever.

session5-paris-secrets.fullTranslation: Paris is particularly well-known. It is also known by the name City of Light. Children often play outdoors. There are many places to visit. To name just three: the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, and Montmartre. Here is a funny anecdote. Did you know that its height has changed several times? That story alone is worth the detour. His guide thinks it's true. Because he read it in a book. At that moment, everyone waited. Have you visited his favorite places? You have to go quickly. Because nothing lasts forever.

glossary.english: also known by the name of
